lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary horizontal series of five high-luminance circular blobs is visible along the mid-lateral flank, with a secondary parallel row of less-defined blobs positioned ventrally. The clusters are arranged in a roughly equidistant 2D grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a rectangular grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by linear high-intensity pixel peaks with sharp vertical gradients into shadow regions immediately below, oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, horizontally elongated feature is visible posterior to the fifth branchial slit. Irregular depigmented patches or white abrasions are present on the dorsal-lateral surface above the gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast light caustic patterns from surface water refraction are superimposed over the dorsal and upper lateral surfaces, creating a net-like overlay of varying pixel intensities.
